name: Antidiskriminierungsstelle des Bundes
description: Federal information and counselling resource for people experiencing discrimination or sexual harassment.

name: Deutsches Institut für Menschenrechte
description: Germany's independent national human rights institution, with research, monitoring, documentation and human-rights education.

name: Bundeszentrale für politische Bildung
description: Public political-education resources on democracy, government, fundamental rights, history and current political questions.

name: Amadeu Antonio Stiftung
description: Supports democratic civil society and people confronting racism, antisemitism and right-wing violence and extremism.

name: PRO ASYL
description: Information, advocacy and contact options concerning asylum and refugee rights in Germany and Europe.

name: TelefonSeelsorge Deutschland
description: Free, anonymous crisis and emotional support by telephone, chat and email, available day and night.

name: Verbraucherzentrale
description: Consumer information and counselling through Germany's state consumer centres.

name: Legal Defense Fund
description: Civil-rights legal organization advancing racial justice, voting rights, education equity, economic justice and criminal-justice reform.

name: American Civil Liberties Union
description: Civil-liberties organization with practical Know Your Rights material, including voting and discrimination resources.

name: Equal Justice Initiative
description: Works against racial and economic injustice, excessive punishment and mass incarceration while documenting America's history of racial injustice.

name: Library of Congress: African American History Online
description: Research guide connecting readers to digitized primary sources documenting more than 400 years of African American experience.

name: National Archives: African American Heritage
description: Federal archival records and research guides covering slavery, Reconstruction, civil rights, voting rights and the broader Black experience.

name: FOIA.gov
description: Official federal guide for requesting records from executive agencies under the Freedom of Information Act.

name: National Labor Relations Board: Employee Rights
actions: File or research a labor charge
description: Official information about protected concerted activity, organizing and federal labor-law rights for covered employees.

name: U.S. Department of Labor: Wage and Hour Division
description: Official federal wage-and-hour enforcement resource, including minimum wage, overtime and retaliation information.

name: OSHA Whistleblower Protection Program
description: Official information about retaliation protections administered by OSHA under multiple federal statutes.

name: §14 SGB I — Anspruch auf Beratung
description: German Social Code provision giving everyone a right to advice about rights and duties under the Social Code.

name: §25 SGB X — Akteneinsicht
description: German social-administrative provision governing file inspection by participants in covered proceedings.

name: Betriebsverfassungsgesetz
description: Official text of Germany's Works Constitution Act, including works-council eligibility, complaint rights and co-determination provisions.

name: U.S. Commission on Civil Rights — Complaint Referral
description: Independent federal civil-rights watchdog. Investigates and reports on civil-rights issues; its referral service helps locate complaint offices. It does not represent complainants or enforce remedies.

name: U.S. Department of Justice — Civil Rights Reporting
description: Official portal to report possible federal civil-rights violations, including discrimination and certain law-enforcement misconduct. Reporting does not guarantee investigation, representation, or compensation.

name: Oversight.gov — Federal Inspectors General
description: Search federal inspector-general audits and investigations and find reporting channels. Inspectors general can investigate and recommend action but generally cannot award individual damages.

name: GAO FraudNet — Report Federal Waste or Abuse
actions: Report suspected federal fraud or misuse
description: Receives allegations involving federal funds, waste, abuse and mismanagement, and refers appropriate matters. Not an individual civil-rights compensation or legal representation service.

name: Government Accountability Office — Reports
description: Congressional audit agency documenting federal program performance, failures and recommendations. Its reports are evidence for accountability, not binding awards of compensation.

name: Brennan Center for Justice
description: Nonpartisan law and policy institute researching democracy, voting rights, justice systems and government reform. Not a general individual complaint-resolution service.

name: Project On Government Oversight (POGO)
description: Independent nonprofit watchdog investigating federal misconduct, waste, conflicts of interest and oversight failures. Not a court or compensation agency.

name: ProPublica — Investigative Journalism
description: Independent nonprofit newsroom investigating abuses of power and public-interest failures. Reporting can expose wrongdoing but cannot compel legal remedies.

name: Leadership Conference on Civil and Human Rights
description: Coalition advocating for civil and human rights legislation, enforcement and accountability. Advocacy and policy work are not a substitute for legal representation.

name: NAACP — Civil Rights Advocacy
description: Civil-rights membership organization working on racial justice, voting, education and public accountability. Local assistance and legal referrals vary.
